d: Wireless Presentation System with 2 Buttons for Hybrid Rooms

specs.label: Video outputs
specs.value: 4K UHD (3840*2160) @ 30Hz. HDMI™ 1.4b or USB-C DisplayPort 1.2 (only Gen2)

specs.label: Authentication protocol
specs.value: WPA2-PSK in stand alone mode; WPA2-PSK or IEEE 802.1X using the ClickShare Button in network integration mode

specs.label: Reach
specs.value: Adjustable with signal strength modulation; max. 30m (100 ft) between ClickShare Button and ClickShare Base Unit; Frequency band 2.4 GHZ and 5 GHz

specs.label: Frequency band
specs.value: 2.4 GHZ and 5 GHz (DFS channels supported in select number of countries)

specs.label: Connections
specs.value: 1x Ethernet LAN 1Gbit; 1x USB-C 2.0 (front); 1x USB-A 2.0 (front) - only Gen2: 1x USB-C 3.0 (front); 1x USB-A 3.0 (front)
